title: The ant city: exercises
subtitle: Five exercises on the text
label: Exercises
review: Written by Claude from the lesson text. Check the English and the answers before using it with learners.

items.q: Leafcutter ants live in a tropical rainforest.
Leafcutter ants cut leaves with their legs.
Leafcutter ants eat the leaves they carry.
The ants clean their fungus gardens every day.
Medium-sized workers cut and carry leaves.
The queen ant is much smaller than the workers.
Where are the ants going with the leaves?
items.why: “They are going home to their underground city!”

items.q: What are the rooms in Ant City called?
items.why: “The tunnels connect many rooms called chambers.”

items.q: What do the ants grow with the pieces of leaves?
items.why: “They use these pieces to grow a special fungus.”

items.q: What protects the fungus from certain diseases?
items.why: “Some ants have helpful bacteria on their bodies. These bacteria make substances that protect the fungus from certain diseases.”

items.q: What is the queen's most important job?
items.why: “Her most important job is to lay eggs.”

blocks.title: 4. Open questions
blocks.note: These questions are open. Talk about your answers with your teacher or a classmate.

items.q: Without looking at the text, sum it up in three sentences.
items.model: Leafcutter ants cut leaves and carry them to their underground city. They do not eat the leaves: they use them to grow a fungus, and the fungus is their food. Every ant has a job, and the queen lays the eggs.

items.q: Do leafcutter ants eat the leaves? What do they do with them?
items.model: No. Small worker ants chew the leaves into tiny pieces and use them to grow a special fungus. The fungus is their food.

items.q: How do the ants take care of their fungus gardens?
items.model: They clean them every day. They remove harmful bits and mold. Some ants have helpful bacteria that protect the fungus from diseases.

items.q: What jobs do the large, the medium-sized and the tiny workers do?
items.model: Large workers help protect the colony. Medium-sized workers cut and carry leaves. Tiny workers care for the fungus gardens and the young ants.

items.q: Which job in Ant City would you like to do? Why?

blocks.title: 5. Put in order
blocks.intro: Put the steps in the order of the text.
items: The ants cut leaves with their jaws
They carry the leaves home to their underground city
Small workers chew the leaves into tiny pieces
The ants grow a fungus with the leaf pieces
The fungus becomes the ants' food
